skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this image into a 5-second animated video clip — and get animated vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "OpenAI Image to Video" skill.
- Instantly convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 5-second animated video clips using AI — no editing software required.
- Supports quick setup with automatic anonymous token generation and secure cloud processing.
- Simple chat prompts route actions for image upload, video generation, export, and credit status.
- All video creation and rendering handled remotely; download results in 30–60 seconds.
- Includes error handling, session management, and workflow tips for best results.
